facts.fact: Over 3.1 billion gamers exist worldwide, according to DFC Intelligence as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: With over [3.1 billion gamers](https://www.dfcint.com/global-video-game-consumer-population/) worldwide, the gaming industry is now estimated to exceed [$300 billion](https://newsroom.accenture.com/news/global-gaming-industry-value-now-exceeds-300-billion-new-accenture-report-finds.htm) USD.

facts.fact: The gaming industry is estimated to exceed $300 billion USD, according to an Accenture report cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: the gaming industry is now estimated to exceed [$300 billion](https://newsroom.accenture.com/news/global-gaming-industry-value-now-exceeds-300-billion-new-accenture-report-finds.htm) USD.

facts.fact: In 2021, gamers spent about 8 hours and 27 minutes each week playing games, per a TechRepublic article cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: In 2021, gamers spent about [8 hours and 27 minutes](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/8-hours-and-27-minutes-thats-how-long-the-average-gamer-plays-each-week/) each week playing games

facts.fact: The average gaming session time is 1 hour and 20 minutes.
facts.quote: with an average session time of 1 hour and 20 minutes.

facts.fact: A 2021 study cited by StackAdapt found that 55% of gamers identified as male.
facts.quote: A [2021](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/generational-marketing) study showed that 55% of gamers identified as male

facts.fact: A 2021 study cited by StackAdapt found that 45% of gamers identified as female.
facts.quote: and 45% identified as female, while most gamers are found across a few [generations](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/generational-marketing), between the ages of 25-54

facts.fact: Per a Fullscreen study cited by StackAdapt, gamers who game more than 10 hours a week have 2x more disposable income than non-gamers.
facts.quote: those who game more than 10 hours a week have [2x more disposable income](https://www.tubefilter.com/2018/10/02/fullscreen-study-discretionary-income-gamers/) than non-gamers.

facts.fact: According to Anzu research cited by StackAdapt, 51% of gamers advise others on purchasing decisions.
facts.quote: 51% of gamers advise others and 47% influence others, especially when it comes to purchasing decisions.

facts.fact: According to Anzu research cited by StackAdapt, 79% of gamers say socializing and new experiences are important to them.
facts.quote: Anzu also found that 79% of gamers say socializing and new experiences are important to them

facts.fact: According to Anzu research cited by StackAdapt, 46% of gamers try to be the first to know about new products and services.
